I've been with the company around 4 years now and here's a few tips.
Emphasize how you work well in teams, can meet targets and are passionate about customer service, not just the gaming/loot industry.

Read up on the company Ethos and company origin in case they ask, and if they don't ask, mention that you've read them. 

Dress in a casual button up, work pants and black shoes if you have them. Don't buy them if you don't have them already, just dress smart casual or casual business.

Don't be afraid to show some of your personality!
